_comment: Resolved base image pin for the training container. Every value here was read
from the registry and from the image's own config blob and layer history -- not
from a tag label and not from documentation. src/grpo_sagemaker/build_image.py
re-resolves this at build time and must agree; docs/container.md renders it as
Why this tag: it is the newest verlai/verl image whose vLLM, Python, and CUDA
versions all clear Requirement 6.2's floors. The newer vllm020/023/024 tags also
clear them but ship CUDA 13.0.2, which needs a much newer host NVIDIA driver than
SageMaker training AMIs are guaranteed to carry; CUDA 12.9.1 benefits from CUDA
minor-version compatibility instead. Revisit if a CUDA 12.x image with a higher
Note the tag is a .dev build. That is not a stability compromise here: the image
is consumed by immutable digest, and no non-dev verlai/verl tag reaches vLLM
0.18.0 -- the newest '.latest' tag is vllm017.latest at vLLM 0.17.0.

verl.note: Base image runs `pip install git+...verl.git@v0.7.1 && pip uninstall -y verl`, so it carries veRL's dependency closure but not veRL. container/requirements-container.txt adds it back with --no-deps.

evidence.vllm: layer history: RUN pip install vllm==0.18.0
evidence.torch: layer history: RUN pip install torch==2.10.0 torchvision==0.25.0 torchaudio==2.10.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu129
evidence.transformers: layer history: RUN pip install transformers==5.3.0
evidence.flash_attn: layer history: RUN ... pip install --no-build-isolation flash_attn==2.8.3
evidence.verl: layer history: RUN pip install git+https://github.com/volcengine/verl.git@v0.7.1 && pip uninstall -y verl
evidence.naming_convention: vllm017.latest ships vllm==0.17.0 and vllm018.dev1 ships vllm==0.18.0, confirming that a zero-padded packed tag component 0MM denotes version 0.MM

constraints_satisfied.verdict: all three floors met as originally specified; no floor was relaxed
